title: Mapping (Crosswalk) Record
description: One crosswalk assertion between two terms in different schemes, e.g. ETIM EC000466 -> master product term 'power-transmission.bearings.ball-bearings.deep-groove', or UNSPSC 31171504 -> same. SKOS mapping semantics. Bulk mappings are authored in CSV (taxonomy/crosswalks/*.csv) and generated into these records; each keeps its method and confidence so automated (rule/AI) suggestions can sit beside human-approved ones. The auto-classifier walks: identifiers on the incoming product (etim_class, unspsc, hts, vendor category) -> mapping records with status active -> master term.

relations.description: Exactly one rel='source' and one rel='target' edge, both to taxonomy_term records.

scheme.description: Scheme the source term belongs to (slug, e.g. etim).

path.description: Source term's dotted path in its scheme.

label.description: Source term's name, kept so the mapping reads without lookups.

source.description: Denormalized for display; rel='source' is authoritative.

target.description: The term the source maps to.

scheme.description: Scheme the target term belongs to (slug, e.g. product).

path.description: Target term's dotted path in its scheme.

match.description: SKOS: exactMatch, closeMatch, broadMatch (target is broader), narrowMatch (target is narrower), relatedMatch.

confidence.description: How sure the mapping is, 0 to 1 (1 = certain).

rule.description: For method=rule: the rule expression or id.

$comment: Envelope status drives use: draft = suggestion awaiting review, active = approved and used by the auto-classifier, withdrawn = rejected (kept so it is not re-suggested).

examples.label: ETIM EC000466 -> Deep groove ball bearings
